#### Section 4: Data Flow & Interaction Edge Cases

```

    │             │              │                │             │              │

                              [all reject]                    [network]       → optimistic
                               → 200, 3 errors,                → error+Retry    clear + refetch
                               page-level notice
```
**Async ordering (mark-all-read vs refetch):** shared state = `notifications` panel data.
```
  t  | MarkAllRead POST        | useDashboard refetch (Retry/focus) | notifications state
  1  | submitting (snapshot S) |                                    | unread list
  2  |                         | GET starts                         | unread list
  3  | 200 → optimistic clear  |                                    | []
  4  |                         | GET returns pre-read data          | unread list  ← STALE
```
Order 3-then-4 reverts the optimistic clear. Mechanism to prevent: refetch triggered on mutation success (after 3), and any in-flight GET started before the POST resolved is discarded by a request sequence counter. Test both orders with controlled promise resolution.
